content.comment_body: I have a CPU [article_no] with a [article_no] RTD expansion module. Occasionally, when powering up the system, the CPU does not detect the expansion module correctly, resulting in all analog inputs showing minimum values. I tried swapping both the CPU and the expansion module, but the issue persists. Power is supplied to all modules simultaneously. What can I do to resolve this issue? Thank you
You could try increasing the startup delay for the [product_name] base module. This might help resolve the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences a problem where, during system startup, the analog RTD expansion module is intermittently not detected by the CPU, leading to minimum readings on all analog inputs. They have ruled out hardware faults by replacing components and confirmed that all modules receive power at the same time, suggesting the issue may be related to startup timing or initialization procedures.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable detection and initialization of the RTD expansion module by the CPU at every startup, ensuring accurate analog readings are available immediately.
